comment: 55yo male, native of Northeast Thailand (Isaan / Mekong region), lifelong consumption of koi pla (raw freshwater fish dish) until age 40. Stool ova-positive for O. viverrini on prior testing (2012, treated with praziquantel); serology remains positive. No current cholangiocarcinoma diagnosis. O. viverrini IARC Group 1 carcinogen — established etiological driver of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma in the Mekong basin (Northeast Thailand has world's highest CCA incidence up to 90/100K; endemic attributable fraction >50%). Praziquantel cures active infection but does NOT reverse chronic biliary-tract inflammation / fibrosis. Engine fires RF-OPISTHORCHIS-CHOLANGIO-PREVENTION (any_of: opisthorchis_viverrini_history:positive OR opisthorchis_viverrini_ova_stool:positive OR opisthorchis_viverrini_serology:positive) and routes to PreventionPlan: standard = lifelong hepatobiliary surveillance (liver US + CA 19-9 q12mo from age 40 in heavily-exposed cohorts); alternative = symptom-triggered evaluation. Validates v0.3 §20 less-common infectious pilot. Anchored DIS-CHOLANGIOCARCINOMA.
